svg.desc: Matriz de stack por grupos. E-commerce y CMS: WordPress, WooCommerce, PrestaShop 1.7, Divi, Elementor, Astra, WoodMart, WPBakery, FiboSearch, Moodle; Pagos y envíos: Redsys · Bizum, PayPal, Klarna, Sendcloud, GLS; Marketing y marketplaces: Google Merchant Center, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Channable, SEO / SEM, Google Shopping, TikTok Shop, eBay, Amazon; Hosting y seguridad: IONOS, Cloudflare, DNS, Apache2, OPcache, Wordfence, UpdraftPlus; Sistemas y redes: Ubuntu Server, Debian, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS y DHCP, VirtualBox, XAMPP; Herramientas: Git, GitHub, IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, NetBeans, Maven, Swagger, Lombok, IA (Claude, ChatGPT).
